Subject: Coupa invite - OTP failing on first-time login

Hi Irene,

We received the supplier invite this morning but every time our user tries to complete the 'Accept invite' flow the OTP never appears — the page reloads to a redirect URL and shows a blank acceptance screen. We tried from Chrome (desktop) and Safari on iOS.

Steps we took:
- Click invite link in email -> redirected to coupa.example.com/accept?token=XXX
- Page flashes, then redirects to our IdP for SSO metadata, then back to a blank accept page.
- No OTP prompt appears; no error text.

Screenshot attached (coupa-otp-screenshot.png). This is blocking our AP set up for the Q3 PO tests. We need a quick workaround or a resend with a different invite format.

Thanks Sam — sorry for the trouble. Appreciate the screenshot. Two quick asks while we triage:

1) Can you confirm whether the invite was opened from a corporate VPN / proxy?
2) If possible, please forward the raw invite email headers (we're checking for link rewriting).

Initial notes from our side: Ben has seen similar symptoms when the Accept flow is navigated with a redirect that strips same-site cookies — the OTP widget is hosted on a subdomain and the cookie affinity can be lost. Ben, can you validate whether our invite generator emitted the shorter accept link (vs. the full redirector)?

Workaround for now: Ben can resend an invite that points to the full accept URL (no short redirector) and we can also temporarily toggle the OTP delivery to email-only for that invite.

I've opened Jira PROC-4521 and assigned to Ben for triage; Laura, FYI on the customer impact. Sam, I'll follow up with a new invite link within the hour if possible.

Best,

Hi all — thanks for the details and the screenshot, Sam. I pulled the accept link from the invite token you provided and reproduced the flow in our staging: the redirector service is appending a referrer param that triggers our short-link handler, which then performs a 302 to the IdP and back. In that round-trip the same-site cookie used by the OTP widget is being marked "Lax" and is not being sent on the cross-site POST, so the widget thinks it's a fresh session and never renders the OTP input.

Plan:
- Resend a new invite that uses the canonical full accept URL (bypass short-link redirector).
- Flip the OTP delivery method to email-only for the new invite (so even if the widget fails, the code arrives).
- Add a temporary exception in the short-link service so future invites to the Asterion domain are not rewritten while we patch cookie flags.

I've attached the console trace from the staging repro (see inline notes in the screenshot). Sending the resend now.

Ticket: PROC-4521 (assigned to me).
